citation_set_pr.measures: did art-paper surface the gold's precedent works + theory (lineage/discourse layer)

anchoring_rate.measures: fraction of reception/novelty/capability claims carrying an observable anchor or explicit hedge
anchoring_rate.note: examples omitted in public repro (reconstruction text)

structural_coverage.measures: did the output produce the expected Pattern-1 layers

contamination_probe.measures: verbatim/semantic overlap with gold — READ IN REVERSE
contamination_probe.note: High overlap ⇒ memorization flag (methodology §3 inversion rule), NOT a good result.

per_layer_similarity.measures: transferable layers should converge (higher), generative layers diverge (lower) — descriptive
per_layer_similarity.note: transferable/generative similarity computed on grouped layer blobs, robust to whether a paper splits or nests work vs. realization.
